purpose: Cover every regime-classifier branch without tuning against market or PnL

lifecycle.idea: Cover classes absent from the short modelled sample without retuning thresholds
lifecycle.hypothesis: Four deterministic return paths exercise every classifier branch
lifecycle.critique: Constructed paths guarantee branch exercise and say nothing about likelihood or accuracy
lifecycle.decision: Accept branch coverage; reject all market and performance inferences
lifecycle.lesson: Missing sample classes should be tested with isolated fixtures, not threshold tuning

limitations: No historical likelihood or regime accuracy
No execution, spread, liquidity, events or strategy PnL
verification: duplicate IDs and impossible returns fail closed
lessons: Synthetic fixtures are useful when clearly separated from evidence data
Branch coverage is not predictive validity
Do not trade or optimize against constructed stress paths
